description: This file defines the 'writeexcel_format' class, which represents a style or format for cells in an Excel spreadsheet using BIFF records. It includes methods for creating, copying, and serializing cell formats with various styling options such as font, alignment, borders, and colors.

classes.name: writeexcel_format
classes.description: A class encapsulating cell style properties and methods to generate BIFF records for Excel formats.

methods.name: writeexcel_format
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a format object with default style properties or user-provided properties.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies style properties from another writeexcel_format object.

methods.name: get_xf
methods.description: Generates and returns a BIFF record for the cell format, serialized as binary data.

methods.name: get_font
methods.description: Generates and returns a BIFF record defining font attributes.

methods.name: get_font_key
methods.description: Returns a unique hash key representing the font properties, useful for font deduplication.

methods.name: get_xf_index
methods.description: Returns the index of the format object for referencing in cell records.

methods.name: _get_color
methods.description: Converts a color name or value into a numeric color index used in BIFF records.

methods.name: set_align
methods.description: Sets horizontal alignment of cell text based on human-readable string.

methods.name: set_valign
methods.description: Sets vertical alignment of cell text; calls set_align internally for simplicity.

methods.name: set_merge
methods.description: Sets cell to merge with others by setting horizontal alignment to 'merge'.

methods.name: set_bold
methods.description: Sets font weight to normal or bold.

methods.name: set_border
methods.description: Sets all borders of the cell to the specified style.

methods.name: set_border_color
methods.description: Sets all cell border colors to the specified color.

methods.name: set_properties
methods.description: Bulk sets multiple style properties from an array or list of key-value pairs.

methods.name: set_text_justlast
methods.description: Sets justification last option for text.
